cover_letter.objective: A seasoned Data Scientist with over 7 years of experience in developing and deploying machine learning models, particularly in the domains of Natural Language Processing (NLP), computer vision, and predictive analytics. I am eager to apply my expertise in deep learning frameworks, cloud platforms, and MLOps to contribute to innovative projects at your company. My background aligns perfectly with your requirements for a candidate skilled in Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and experienced in leading projects from conception to production.

highlights: Led a team of 5 data scientists to develop and deploy a state-of-the-art NLP model for sentiment analysis, improving accuracy by 15% and processing over 1M customer reviews daily.
Architected and implemented a scalable MLOps pipeline using Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS SageMaker, reducing model deployment time from 2 weeks to 2 days.
Spearheaded a computer vision project for automated quality inspection, utilizing PyTorch and OpenCV, which reduced defect escape rate by 30%.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams including product managers and software engineers to integrate ML models into production systems, ensuring scalability and reliability.
Mentored junior data scientists and established best practices for code review, version control (Git), and model documentation.
Developed predictive models for customer churn using Python, scikit-learn, and XGBoost, resulting in a 20% reduction in churn rate for key segments.
Built and maintained ETL pipelines using Apache Spark and SQL to process large-scale datasets (10+ TB) for model training and feature engineering.
Designed and executed A/B tests to evaluate model performance and business impact, presenting findings to senior leadership.
Implemented real-time inference APIs using Flask and FastAPI, serving models to downstream applications with 99.9% uptime.

projects.name: Multi-Modal Fraud Detection System
projects.tech_stack: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, OpenCV, AWS, Docker, FastAPI
highlights: Engineered a deep learning model combining NLP (for transaction descriptions) and computer vision (for document verification) to detect fraudulent activities.
Achieved a 25% improvement in fraud detection precision compared to previous rule-based systems.
Deployed the model as a microservice on AWS EKS, ensuring high availability and low-latency inference.

projects.name: Automated Code Review Assistant
projects.tech_stack: Python, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, Pinecone, Streamlit
highlights: Fine-tuned a Large Language Model (LLM) on a dataset of code reviews to generate actionable suggestions for improving code quality and security.
Integrated the model with a vector database (Pinecone) for efficient retrieval of similar code snippets and best practices.
Developed a user-friendly interface using Streamlit for internal teams, increasing developer adoption by 40%.

education.degree: Master of Science in Computer Science
